generalInfo.generalRule: All patrons and bags are subject to search prior to entering Capital One Arena. To increase fan safety and expedite entry, Capital One Arena has implemented a strict no bag policy. Bags, backpacks, and purses will not be permitted inside the arena. Only wallet-size clutches, no larger than 5x7, will be permitted into the arena. Small medical and parenting bags will be permitted on a case by case basis and will be subject to increased security screening. If you are bringing a medical or parenting bag, please use the entrance on the corner of 6th and F Street. Any guest who declines to be searched or is in possession of prohibited items may be denied entry or ejected from the facility. Capital One Arena does not allow fans and patrons to bring in outside food or beverages. For more information on Capital One Arena security and bag policies and a list of prohibited items please click here https://www.capitalonearena.com/articles/capital-one-arena-security-policy Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

events.name: Welcome Back HU!: A FUNDRAISER
events.info: We're back for part 2! Come celebrate Howard's Homecoming with Open Bar, Amazing Djs, and old friends all while giving back to current students at HU. Food and bottle service are available. THE OFFICIAL PARTY OF THE 15 YEAR CELEBRATION FOR HOWARD UNIVERSITY CLASS OF 2011 The Fundraiser: $5 per ticket sold OR 20% of party revenue (whichever is greater) will be donated as a scholarship to a current Howard student for the 26'-27' school year via the HU Alumni Association. TABLES: The table reservation fee secures admission for the specified number of guests at a discounted rate. Tables are subject to a minimum bottle purchase requirement, and all bottle purchases will be billed separately to the table. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive an email to select your bottles and pay the remaining balance. Tax and gratuity are included. Thank you to the Howard University Class of 2011 and The Hard Rock Cafe for your hard work and in kind donation to our cause! *21+ ONLY EVENT* *ALL SALES ARE FINAL* *TICKETS AND TABLES CAN BE TRANSFERRED, BUT NOT REFUNDED*

events.name: GLOW Block Party: The Chainsmokers
events.pleaseNote: The GLOW Block Party returns to Pennsylvania Ave on Saturday, October 17th for another massive outdoor dance party, headlined by Grammy-winning duo The Chainsmokers in their first large-scale DC performance in seven years. They?ll be joined by house music heavyweight MK, rising producer Lavern, DC?s own Eyezic, Emmy Adelle, plus a full Homegrown Stage showcasing some of the best local talent our city has to offer. For one day, one of DC?s most iconic streets becomes the dance floor, bringing together some of the biggest names in electronic music, rising artists, and homegrown talent. We?re bringing Pennsylvania Avenue to life with world-class production, local food vendors, art installations, activations, and more. From the main stage to the Homegrown Stage, the GLOW Block Party is a full-day experience in the heart of DC. Just steps from the Capitol, National Gallery of Art, and National Archives, the GLOW Block Party runs from 3?9:30pm on Saturday, October 17th.
